# Sound gen

Generates `assets/sounds/click.wav`, `row.wav`, `board.wav` and `music.wav`
by synthesizing raw PCM directly in code (sine partials with an envelope,
hand-rolled WAV header) — no audio library, no external assets, same
"generated by code" approach as `tools/app-icon`.

```bash
cd tools/sound-gen
node make-sounds.mjs
```

These are **placeholders**, not final audio — simple synthesized tones
standing in for a stone-placement click, a row-complete chime, a
board-complete fanfare, and a quiet looping ambient pad, so the sound
plumbing (`src/audio/`) has something real to play while the app waits on
proper sound design. Replace the files in `assets/sounds/` with produced
audio whenever it's ready; nothing else needs to change, since the app
always loads these four files by the same names.

`music.wav`'s voice frequencies and tremolo rates are each chosen as an
exact multiple of `1 / LOOP_SECONDS`, so every voice completes a whole
number of cycles over the loop and the waveform is back at exactly 0 at
both ends — it loops with `player.loop = true` with no click or crossfade.
